title: B-tree cursor hint flags

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeCursorHintFlags replaces the cursor hint byte with exactly zero, BULKLOAD, or SEEK_EQ, and sqlite3BtreeCursorHasHint tests a requested hint mask. Together they own the direct cursor-hint state boundary.

external_source_responsibilities: Planner generation and B-tree optimization consumption of hints
dependencies.caller_closure: Both direct hint bodies are assigned; planner/seek integration remains open.

inputs: Live Cursor and replacement hint in {0,BULKLOAD=1,SEEK_EQ=2}; arbitrary mask for observation
outputs: Replaced hint byte and true iff any requested mask bit is present
contracts.state_and_results: Setter replaces rather than ORs. Predicate computes nonzero bitwise intersection.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns cursor serialization; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Unsupported setter value violates source assertion; valid values are infallible.

representation_differences: Typed u8 hint storage replaces source unsigned input narrowed to BtCursor.hints.
Source has-hint is assertion-only in upstream callers but remains a production helper under the active inventory.

oracle.protocol: Set SEEK_EQ=2, assert mask 2 is present and BULKLOAD=1 is absent.
oracle.normalization: Hint values and mask semantics are exact.

assurance.continuation: Hint remains available to later cursor operations until replaced.

integration.native_call_path: Typed hint state and both mask outcomes are unit-traced; planner/seek consumers remain pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires planner/seek integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

implementation_spans: src/core/internal/btree_core.zig Cursor state and tests were reviewed
callers: VDBE cursor open/planner code and assertion checks
Unit trace invokes both owners directly
callees: No callees; direct byte store and mask read
assertions_branches_cleanup: Setter accepts only exact source values
upstream_tests: Upstream cursor hint, planner, index seek, and bulkload tests cover these helpers
Project unit trace covers SEEK_EQ present/BULKLOAD absent
